ModMetaData.name: Aragorn – Armee der Toten (Entwicklungsstand)
ModMetaData.author: Aragorn Mod Project
ModMetaData.description: Version 0.19: Rebalances Divine Order forging to seven waves over six in-game hours, arriving roughly every 51 minutes of active forging (about one seventh faster). The ghost king now reports the actual damage dealt by his five lightning strikes after modded defenses and armor. Retains v0.18: visible, independently facing and aiming original weapons for all thirteen spectral ghosts. Sword Ghost I temporarily uses the weapon-free Sword Ghost II body art to prevent an overlapping pre-painted sword. Only Aragorn can recall summoned ghosts. King Lightning now validates its maximum 15-cell range and shows only valid targets. Summoning, sword whirl and king lightning show live seconds remaining on disabled gizmos (60 ticks per second at normal speed). Dev-mode Aragorn gizmo resets all three cooldowns immediately. Includes the successful v0.17 graphics, English/German quests, Divine Order forging and permanent rescue mission. Playtest recommended.
